items.title: HPE Is the Quiet AI Winner Trading Near Its 52-Week High
items.summary: HPE just shattered its 52-week high on a single session surge, yet its forward multiple still sits far below every major competitor building the same AI infrastructure boom. Something in the valuation math does not add up.

items.title: The Nasdaq Rose 1.9% in September. Intel Exploded 34%
items.summary: Intel jumped 34.32% and AMD gained 29.96%, helping semiconductor stocks lead the advance.

items.title: AMD Doesn’t Need to Beat Nvidia to Be a Big AI Winner
items.summary: AMD's Data Center revenue just doubled and hyperscalers are signing gigawatt-scale deals, yet our model flags a specific risk hiding in plain sight that could send the stock sharply lower before those wins fully materialize.

items.title: HPE Networking Outlook Gets Boost as Barclays, Citi and Wells Fargo Raise Price Targets
items.summary: Citi, Barclays, and Wells Fargo all lifted their HPE price targets after Networking Investor Day, yet the three firms land in very different places on whether the stock's explosive run has already consumed the upside.

items.title: Nvidia’s Latest Move is a Green Light to Keep Loading Up
items.summary: Nvidia just unlocked nearly $100 billion in buyback firepower while demand for its chips outstrips supply through 2028, and the valuation tells a story most investors are reading backwards.

items.title: The Hyperscaler CPU Threat to AMD No One Is Talking About
items.summary: AMD just posted its fifth straight record quarter for server CPUs, yet a quiet structural shift in the cloud threatens to cap how far that streak can run. The answer hinges on one upcoming chip and which hyperscalers choose to deploy it.
